- [LLOG.2.7.2] **Distinct slot values don't coalesce.** Two rules emitting
  logical facts of the same schema with different slot values
  produce two separate facts with independent lifetimes. This is the **key-all** (relation)
  case of the declared-key model ([LFAC.1.7.2]): with every
  slot marked `key`, distinct tuples are distinct identities
  and coexist, while identical tuples still coalesce per
  [LLOG.2.7.1].
